# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 charging stand for iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods

**My pick: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand.** WIRED ranks it best overall after testing 30+ models. It charges the iPhone at up to 15W and fast-charges Apple Watch Series 7 or newer. The AirPods case sits on the base. The iPhone pad tilts and works in landscape for StandBy mode. WIRED lists it at $109, with sale prices of about $98, $90 at Amazon and $80 at Best Buy. It has a 2-year warranty and a 36W power supply included. [Buy via WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

## Other good options

| Need | Pick | Price (per the reviews) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fastest | Nomad Stand One Max | $169 | 25W for iPhone and a heavy, stable base. No power adapter is included, and you need a 40W one (Nomad sells one for $25). [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/) |
| Cheapest | ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Charging Station | $80 list, about $40 on Amazon | 15W, and the charger and cable are included. The Apple Watch charger is a separate unit that slots into the back. [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/) |
| Sleeping | Nimble Podium 3-in-1 | $130 | Lies flat so screens stay out of sight, with 25W Qi2. Apple Watch charging is slow, so it suits overnight use. [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/) |
| Desk and travel | Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable (Qi2 25W) | $129.99 | Tallest and most adjustable foldable stand. Includes a 45W adapter with UK/EU plugs. [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html) |
| Compact travel | Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (Qi2) | $110, about $80 on sale | Folds slim, 15W. [WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/) |
| Fast and cooled | ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 (Qi2.2 25W) | $99.99 | Has a fan with an off switch. [Dealectric listing](https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand) |

## Things to know
- **25W matters less than it sounds.** WIRED says 25W isn't widely supported and makes little difference for overnight charging, so 15W models like the Belkin are fine for most people.
- **Check your iPhone for 25W.** On the ESR CryoBoost, 25W applies only to the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. The iPhone Air, 16 and 16 Pro get 20W, and older models get 15W.
- **Check your AirPods case.** It must support wireless charging.
- **About the links:** most go to the review guides, where the retailer buttons are. The Dealectric page is an affiliate site that lists a code, PARTNER18, which it says takes the CryoBoost to about $82 at ESR's store. Confirm the price at checkout.
- Prices come from articles dated between April and October 2026 and may have changed.

If you tell me your iPhone model and whether you want it for the nightstand, desk or travel, I can narrow this to one.
